oe_act_yoshida_shrine_license = {
	icon = proclaim_decree
	type = religiousfaction
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic

	potential = {
		scope:actor.religion = {
			has_religious_factions = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_shinto_yoshida_license_mod }
		}
	}

	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12

	price = price:oe_price_shinto_medium

	ai_prerequisite = {
		religion = religion:shinto
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_shinto_yoshida_license_mod }
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = religion
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_religion"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_act_yoshida_shrine_license
		years = 10
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_shinto_yoshida_license_mod
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = "scope:actor.add_static_modifier_utility(oe_shinto_yoshida_license_mod)"
	}
}

			}
			add_country_modifier = {

				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }

			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = "scope:actor.add_static_modifier_utility(oe_shinto_yoshida_doctrine_mod)"
